title: operations.orders.order.invoice_due
description: An order reached READY under a saved fulfilment policy with a CRM contact as its buyer, so an invoice is owed (INVENTORY-01). Consumed by operations itself (`app.consumers.order_invoice_due`), which resolves `crm_contact_id` into finance's billed party over finance's internal API with no transaction open, then emits `operations.orders.order.invoice_requested`. Exists only to carry that network call out of the READY transaction.

crm_contact_id.description: `operations.orders.customer_id`: a `services/customer` contact id, not a finance customer id.
